title: KET- Reading and Writing part 1--
subject: Reading
description: Choose the best answer A B C

questions.partInstruction: For each question (1-6), choose the best answer (A, B or C).

options.text: Take a friend to the class and they will pay less than you.
You can save money if you come to the class with someone else.
Students only need to go to a lesson once a week.

stimulus.body: Join our French course. Every Sunday and Thursday. Only £10 a lesson, or bring a friend and pay £8 each!

questions.partInstruction: For each question (1-6), choose the best answer (A, B or C).
questions.question: Why did Karen send this email?

options.text: to see if Jessica wants to take part in an event
to find out what Jessica will make
to check that Jessica hasn't forgotten about the cake sale

stimulus.body:
From: Karen
To: Jessica

Hi Jessica,
Guess what! My sailing club is having a cake sale this Friday. Would you like to bake some biscuits?
Karen

questions.question: What is Tommy telling Fred?

options.text: Tommy plans to wait for the 5 o'clock train.
Tommy won't be able to get a train before 3 o'clock.
Tommy has missed the 3 o'clock train.

stimulus.body:
Fred!
I got to the station just as the train was leaving. The next one isn't till 3 o'clock. I'll be there no later than 5!
Tommy
